newsitem.title: USA: PPT Q1 hurt by slowdowns in key accounts.
newsitem.headline: PPT Q1 hurt by slowdowns in key accounts.

text.p: PPT Vision Inc, reporting lower earnings and sales for the January 31 first quarter, attributed the softness to temporary slowdowns in key accounts.
"The company believes this slowdown is related to customer installation cycles and is not indicative of fundamental issues," said president Joseph Christenson in a statement.
PPT Vision, which designs and manufactures machine vision-based automated inspection systems, said unit sales for the first quarter decreased to 86 from 112 in the same fiscal 1996 period.
The company posted net earnings of $5,000 compared to $557,000 a year earlier. Revenue declined to $2.4 million from $3.1 million.
"Until sales growth rebounds we are slowing the rate of growth of operating expenses," Christenson added.
